'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 2 Tom H LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom H]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)|VB4-L-watchyourstep-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2

== Decklist ==

The sheet says the deck is the same as the player's [[2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Tom H LS Watch Your Step (V)|list from the day before]], with these changes: -1 Bacta Tank / +1 Escape Pod V; -1 Imp Atrocity V / +1 K'lor'slug V; -1 Aim High (NGOB) / +1 DDTA V. The list below applies them.

Lines the transcription could not identify are printed as written under '''Not identified'''.
